rule: No process-global mutable state on core paths: pass it through the operation/session context, and spawn child processes with env_clear() plus the session's environment snapshot (GwzCoreSessionDesign O9). This list is the complete inventory of production exceptions. check_process_globals.py fails on anything unlisted and on entries that no longer match, so the list only shrinks. 'debt' entries are scheduled for removal; 'permanent' entries carry no session-relevant state or are imposed by a dependency.

entries.name: SEQUENCE
entries.reason: Temp-name sequence; only fetch_add, no session state.

entries.name: env::var_os
entries.reason: Environment::Process reads Git's redirecting variables from the ambient process when used. Callers should pass Environment::from_vars(captured) and the variant should go (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: TEMP_SEQ
entries.reason: Temp-name sequence; only fetch_add, no session state.

entries.name: CLEANUPS
entries.reason: Process-wide budget of 64 cleanup permits shared by every endpoint; moves with COUNT (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: COUNT
entries.reason: Process-wide cap of 64 SSH setup helpers (GwzRemoteTransportSshAgentDesign 'process-local infrastructure'). Every session in the process shares it, so one session can exhaust another's. Move the supervisor and its budget into the host/session context (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: HUB
entries.reason: Process-wide SSH setup supervisor and reaper thread shared by every endpoint; moves with COUNT (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: INIT
entries.reason: Initialisation lock for HUB; removed with it.

entries.name: Command::new
entries.reason: Spawns the gh credential helper with env_clear() plus the captured environment, the pattern the contract requires of session-path children.

entries.name: NEXT_ID
entries.reason: Auth-owner ID sequence; only fetch_add, no session state.

entries.name: ORPHANS
entries.reason: Process-wide registry of orphaned HTTPS credential-helper children. The code calls it a compatibility shim for callers without an AuthOwner. Make cleanup endpoint/session-owned (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: ORPHAN_REAPING
entries.reason: In-flight count for ORPHANS; removed with it.

entries.name: SLOTS
entries.reason: Process-wide semaphore of 8 HTTPS helper slots shared by all sessions; move the budget into the host/session context (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: NEXT_SESSION
entries.reason: Local HTTPS fixture-session ID sequence; only fetch_add, no session state.

entries.name: NEXT_WORKER
entries.reason: Endpoint ID sequence (checked increment); no session state.

entries.name: Command::new("git")
entries.reason: git tag and git tag -d each inherits the live process environment; spawn it with env_clear() plus the session's snapshot (GwzCoreSessionDesign RemPlan-1, Safety P3-11).

entries.name: Command::new("git")
entries.reason: git commit inherits the live process environment; spawn it with env_clear() plus the session's snapshot (GwzCoreSessionDesign RemPlan-1, Safety P3-11).

entries.name: Command::new("git")
entries.reason: The local-import git fetch fallback inherits the live process environment; spawn it with env_clear() plus the session's snapshot (GwzCoreSessionDesign RemPlan-1, Safety P3-11).

entries.name: env::var_os
entries.reason: Reads HOME and SSH_AUTH_SOCK at the point of use; capture them once at session open (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: git2::opts::set_server_connect_timeout_in_milliseconds
entries.reason: libgit2 has only a process-wide server timeout. Ordinary builds freeze it at startup (GWZDesign 'Native connection/read timeout'); RemPlan B5 gives transport builds session-owned timeouts.

entries.name: git2::opts::set_server_timeout_in_milliseconds
entries.reason: As set_server_connect_timeout_in_milliseconds.

entries.name: Cred::credential_helper
entries.reason: The default backend's HTTPS credential callback lets libgit2 spawn git's configured credential helpers with the live process environment. Run `git credential fill` with env_clear() plus the session's snapshot instead (GwzCoreSessionDesign §5.8, Safety P3-24 of Verdict-2).

entries.name: TIMEOUT_STATE
entries.reason: Freezes libgit2's process-wide timeout at its first value so no request can change it for others (GWZDesign). Transport builds stop consulting it under RemPlan B5.

entries.name: env::home_dir
entries.reason: Resolves '~/' identity paths against the process home directory at the point of use; take it from the captured session/request context (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: Command::new("git")
entries.reason: The commit-log path walk's git rev-list inherits the live process environment; spawn it with env_clear() plus the session's snapshot (GwzCoreSessionDesign RemPlan-1, Safety P3-11).

entries.name: CROSSING
entries.reason: Whether this thread is running a gate crossing's closure or a cancel callback, where crossing or revoking a gate panics instead of deadlocking (session plan CS1.4, S-P3-3). Set only for that closure's run and restored after it; no session state.

entries.name: env::vars_os
entries.reason: with_local_transport snapshots the whole process environment inside core; the driver must capture it and pass it in (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: env::var_os
entries.reason: SshEndpointConfig::from_environment reads HOME and SSH_AUTH_SOCK; capture them once at session open (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: SERIAL
entries.reason: Placement ID sequence (checked increment); no session state.

entries.reason: Temp-name sequence; only fetch_add, no session state.

entries.name: V1_PRESERVATION_IMAGE_CAPTURES
entries.reason: Test-only capture counter compiled into production builds; gate it with cfg(test).
